acceptable_references.label: Section 128
acceptable_references.reason: defines force, which underlies criminal force

required_points: Section 129 defines criminal force as intentionally using force to any person, without that person's consent, in order to commit any offence, or intending by the use of such force to cause, or knowing it likely that it will cause, injury, fear or annoyance to the person to whom the force is used.
optional_points: Section 128 defines force as causing motion, change of motion, or cessation of motion to another person through one's own bodily power or by other means.
forbidden_points: Criminal force requires actual bodily injury.
Criminal force is the same as assault.
